Class GeminiService

public without sharing class GeminiService

Service class for interacting with the Google Gemini AI API. Handles authentication, HTTP communication, and response parsing. Settings (endpoint URL and API key) are retrieved from CodeSettings__mdt and BlazeBiteSettings__c and cached in the org cache for 48 hours.

private static String getResponse(String promptResponse)

Parses the raw JSON response from the Gemini API and extracts the generated text from the first candidate's first content part (candidates[0].content.parts[0].text).

Parameters:
    promptResponse – The raw JSON response body from the Gemini API

Returns:
    String: The extracted generated text

public static GeminiService.Response runPrompt(String prompt)

Sends a prompt to the Gemini API and returns the generated response. Constructs an HTTP POST request with the API key header, sends the prompt as the request body, and parses the first candidate text from the response. Errors are logged via ErrorUtils and returned in the Response.error field.

Parameters:
    prompt – The JSON-formatted prompt body to send to the Gemini API

Returns:
    Response: The API response containing the generated text or an error message
